verdict.rationale: AWS IAM documents OIDC identity providers that connect external CI such as GitHub Actions to AWS resources ([aws-docs-13], [aws-docs-29]). Assuming a role issues temporary security credentials, and roles carry no long-term access keys ([aws-docs-12], [aws-docs-46]); AWS also recommends federation over IAM users ([aws-docs-47]). Missing for 10: an evidenced end-to-end CI OIDC walkthrough (trust policy, token exchange, session duration), workload-identity coverage for services running on AWS, controls to enforce that no long-lived keys exist, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
